svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"rank-cadet-officer-first-lieutenant-cloth-bordered-miniature","name":"Cadet First Lieutenant insignia on cloth (1/8 in border), miniature","size_in":{"w":1,"h":0.625},"units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,100,62.5],"size_source":"regulation","size_citation":"CAPR 39-1 (3 March 2020) Figure A5-6, dimension drawing (inches read from the figure); border: CAPR 39-1 5.1.1.1.1.1 / 5.1.1.1.1.3 (ABU) and 7.1.1.8 (OCP/tactical cap), 1/8 in showing past the widest and tallest point","anchors":{"top_center":[50,0],"bottom_center":[50,62.5],"center":[50,31.25],"left_edge":[0,31.25],"right_edge":[100,31.25],"insignia_center":[50,31.25],"insignia_left":[12.5,31.25],"insignia_right":[87.5,31.25]},"dimensions":{"form":"embroidered on cloth","size":"miniature","border_each_side_in":0.125,"insignia_w_in":0.75,"insignia_h_in":0.375,"cloth_w_in":1,"cloth_h_in":0.625},"mounts":[{"uniform":"ABU / BDU / blue field coat collar","rule":"regular size (Colonels and Captains may wear miniature), centered 1 in from the FRONT of the collar, 1/8 in of blue showing past the widest and tallest point (5.1.1.1.1.3, 5.1.2.2.4, 5.2.1.1.1.4).
